title: Camera transition with pull-out (0.9.169)
intro: Release the pawn, Reset Scripts. Stand with the party around you. Press End (or click both sticks) to start.

steps.text: Take over pawns and come back a few times, including pawn to pawn, and some pawns behind you or far off. The camera should pull back and up first so both are in view, then glide behind the new one.
Done. Tell Claude how it felt: too slow / too fast, too much slow-down, anything odd.

probes.ts: local tm=sdk.get_managed_singleton('app.TimeManager'); return tm and string.format('%.2f', tm:call('get_TimeScale')) or '-'
probes.who: local d=_G.DPC_dbg; local s=d and d.state; if not s then return '-' end; return s.active and tostring(s.pawn_name) or 'Arisen'
probes.cam: local d=_G.DPC_dbg; local R=d and d.R; local s=d and d.state; local tgt = (R and R.cine and R.cine.chara) or (s and (s.active and s.pawn_chara or s.arisen_chara)); if not tgt then return '-' end; local j=sdk.get_managed_singleton('app.CameraManager'):call('getMainCameraController',0):get_field('_CameraJoint'); local p=j:call('get_Position'); local r=j:call('get_Rotation'); local f={x=2*(r.x*r.z+r.w*r.y), y=2*(r.y*r.z-r.w*r.x), z=1-2*(r.x*r.x+r.y*r.y)}; local q=tgt:call('get_GameObject'):call('get_Transform'):call('get_Position'); local dx,dy,dz=q.x-p.x,q.y+1.4-p.y,q.z-p.z; local l=math.sqrt(dx*dx+dy*dy+dz*dz); local c=(-f.x*dx-f.y*dy-f.z*dz)/l; return string.format('%.1fm %ddeg', l, math.floor(math.deg(math.acos(math.max(-1,math.min(1,c))))+0.5))
probes.camgo: local tr=sdk.get_primary_camera():call('get_GameObject'):call('get_Transform'); local p=tr:call('get_Position'); local j=sdk.get_managed_singleton('app.CameraManager'):call('getMainCameraController',0):get_field('_CameraJoint'):call('get_Position'); return string.format('%.1f', math.sqrt((p.x-j.x)^2+(p.y-j.y)^2+(p.z-j.z)^2))
